Management stated the following regarding margins:

* **TEAL:** Normalized margins will gradually gravitate toward 12%–16%, though full-year margins could be higher [1].
* **CaratLane:** Margins should inch toward a double-digit EBIT margin (~10%–11%) [1]. 
* **Drivers:** Margin dynamics are primarily driven by category mix (coins, plain gold, and diamonds) [7].

**Did they deliver?**
* **CaratLane:** Delivered a 9.6% (9%+ upwards) EBIT margin, moving toward its double-digit target [1].
* **Overall Company:** Consolidated Operating Profit Margin (OPM) dipped to 7.0% in Mar 2026, but expanded to 14.0% in Jun 2026 and Sep 2026 [8].
